description: Minutes until the next metro trains at a station, per line and destination. KRTC, TYMC and KLRT list every station; TRTC (Taipei) only lists trains arriving right now, so an empty Taipei board is normal. Example: system "KRTC", station "美麗島".

station.description: Station name or ID (default: every station).
